segments.text: How is the word made effectual to salvation
The Spirit of God maketh the reading, but especially the preaching, of the Word, an effectual means of convincing and converting sinners,
and of building them up in holiness and comfort, through faith, unto salvation.
Larger Catechism one hundred and fifty-five
How is the Word made effectual to salvation
The Spirit of God maketh the reading, but especially the preaching of the Word, an effectual means of enlightening, convincing, and humbling sinners;
of driving them out of themselves, and drawing them unto Christ; of conforming them to his image, and subduing them to his will;
of strengthening them against temptations and corruptions; of building them up in grace, and establishing their hearts in holiness and comfort through faith unto salvation.
